shared_rules: Only assigned paths. No changes to canonical curriculum, source catalogue, STATUS, shared build/verify or hosting. No child agents or installs. Root owns acceptance and publication. Files are independent original chapter packages, not patches to existing chapters.

Advanced chapter requirements: substantive intuition and formal derivation/proof under stated assumptions, at least3 worked examples and8 complete original exercises with matched full solutions. Include objective/prerequisites, boundaries and counterexamples, teach-back and answered retention, accurate chapter routes, extension and source links. No filler word quota; expected depth beyond an overview.

Use existing HTML component conventions: aside class=worked, numbered original exercises ol class=exercises, details class=solutions; explicit unique anchors. Public asset hrefs are flat filenames. Existing chapter/prerequisite routes must match canonical titles; planned successor links remain clearly labeled planned.

Return notation: G_i=1+R_i, R_i is same-horizon simple total return in common currency; mu=E[R], Sigma=Cov(R). w_i are beginning-wealth exposures summing to one including cash/borrowing when present. State probabilities are supplied positive fictional physical probabilities; no assumed pricing probabilities. Time-varying weights, fee/tax assumptions, short rights and funding rates explicit. Do not average log returns cross-sectionally as portfolio log returns.

c01 teaches total simple/log return, reinvestment/compounding, cash flows/time-weighted versus money-weighted evaluation, costs/fees, currency/inflation, same-date opportunity sets and full-investment budget. c02 develops covariance/PSD/sample common-date estimates. c03 teaches GMV/frontier/tangency, constraints and shrinkage. c04 derives equilibrium; acceptance follows this dependency order even while drafting in parallel.

Reuse verified stable sources only within already inspected scope. Retrieve and inspect primary sources for uncertain or additional specialist claims. Supply exact existing source records or new scoped records as a JSON list; root alone integrates. Sources support methodology, never fictional case observations. No unsupported regulatory/current investment advice.

Original offline lab: synthetic inputs/provenance/units/timing, stdlib Python benchmark quiet import/run, exact rational output where appropriate and justified floating tolerance for irrational/log quantities, complete preserved output, manifest for four distributed files and README with limitations. A named fixed fixture must reject contradictory policy labels or explicitly support alternatives. No general-purpose engine expansion.

Quiet focused checker check() returns strict JSON and independently reconstructs material numerical results and meaningful failure/boundary cases. Review every prompt against full solution and methods taught. Final author JSON includes coverage/gates, findings, source scope and final byte sizes/SHA256 of all eight payloads (excluding its own review record; nine owned paths total); finish/freeze before handoff. Root independently audits everything; no acceptance or human certification claim.

canonical_spec.title: Portfolio mathematics and diversification
canonical_spec.outcome: Compute portfolio risk and explain the role of covariance and concentration.

assignments.scope: Derive portfolio mean and covariance risk from beginning-wealth weights; full covariance-matrix quadratic-form proof, two-asset correlation boundaries, diversified versus common risk, concentration and leveraged/short positions including financing. Distinguish population supplied-state calculations from common-date sample estimates (n-1), missing-data/inconsistent-matrix dangers and estimation uncertainty. Coherent original state/return lab with independent numerical checks; optimization is developed in c03, not silently required here.

canonical_spec.title: Mean-variance optimization and allocation
canonical_spec.outcome: Derive efficient portfolios and assess sensitivity to estimated inputs.

assignments.scope: Derive efficient mean-variance portfolios, unconstrained GMV and target-return frontier with explicit SPD/feasibility/nondegeneracy assumptions; tangency/risk-free allocation and valid sign/normalization conditions; constrained feasible portfolios with justified solution/optimality (small active-set or exact cases suitable for stdlib). Explain limitations of mean-variance preferences and sensitivity to means/covariances. Teach shrinkage with a transparent synthetic perturbation/regularization example and no implied universal optimal estimator. Complete proofs and unfamiliar transfer exercises, not formula survey.

canonical_spec.title: CAPM and equilibrium risk pricing
canonical_spec.outcome: Derive the CAPM mechanism and distinguish its theoretical assumptions from empirical evidence.

assignments.scope: Derive CAPM from investor optimality plus market clearing under explicit common beliefs, horizon, funding and mean-variance assumptions; economic covariance pricing, market portfolio, security versus capital market lines, beta/alpha and portfolio relations. Distinguish ex-ante relation, realized regression and empirical hypothesis; market-proxy/joint-hypothesis and implementation/nontraded-wealth limitations using accurately scoped inspected primary sources. Original coherent pricing/state/return case with reproducible benchmark; no fabricated current empirical findings.
